scope: Public SEC EDGAR 424(b)(2) candidate pricing supplements discovered by official full-text search; candidates require document download and extraction validation.
quality_gate: No record is training data, realized outcome evidence, or OOS evidence until downloaded, hashed, parsed, deduplicated and human-validated.

committee_review.baseline: 0 downloaded and validated candidates before this slice
committee_review.target: 200 official public term-sheet candidates catalogued, then a validated 10-document extraction pilot
committee_review.observed_metric: 200 unique SEC candidate URLs catalogued; 5/5 sampled URLs returned HTTP 200
data_code_config_lineage: search queries: Autocallable Phoenix, Phoenix Securities, worst performing
catalog records preserve accession, CIK, filename, file date and source query
required_pipeline: Download all candidates with retry and SEC rate-limit controls.
Compute SHA-256 hashes and validate content type.
Parse a 10-document subset before scaling extraction.
Deduplicate by accession, URL and document hash.
Use rule-based extraction plus AI-assisted review for barriers, coupons, autocall and worst-of logic.
Human-validate a random sample of at least 10 percent.
Keep extracted terms separate from realized outcomes and OOS labels.
acceptance_tests: Every downloaded document has a valid URL, retrieval timestamp and SHA-256.
A 10-document pilot contains expected Phoenix/worst-of term patterns.
Duplicates and non-document responses are explicitly reported.
No record is promoted to training/OOS without human validation.
committee_review.next_experiment: Download and parse a controlled 10-document subset before scaling to all 200.
blockers: No candidate has yet been downloaded, hashed or parsed at scale.
Search relevance, duplicate rate and document-content validity are not yet measured for all 200.
Human validation is not yet complete.
committee_review.final_devin_validation: Catalog JSON updated; sampled SEC retrieval succeeded 5/5; full download/extraction remains the next bounded slice.
safety_flags: Validate content type and document integrity.
Do not treat pricing supplements as realized outcomes.
